skills.name: career
should_trigger: Help me manage my whole job search and decide what to do next.
I lost my role and need an end-to-end career plan.
Coordinate my career direction, search, applications, interviews, and follow-ups as one workflow.
I need one system to connect my evidence, active opportunities, materials, and pipeline decisions.
Help me restart my search from current-state recovery through a reviewed application plan.
I have scattered resumes, several leads, and an interview next week; before doing any single task, work out the smallest complete career workflow and its next step.
should_not_trigger: Fix this Python unit test.
Only proofread this already final paragraph.
Compare these two written offers and nothing else.
Find fresh remote roles under this saved search policy.

skills.name: application-campaign
should_trigger: Build a reviewed campaign with ten primary applications and two reserves.
Reconcile attempted, blocked, replaced, and acknowledged submissions in this batch.
Plan a five-role application sprint with a frozen roster and per-role approvals.
Create separate artifacts, effect plans, and outcome receipts for every role in this batch.
We have a weekly application quota; track successes, failures, skips, and replacement rules without lowering the evidence gate.
The shortlist is already reviewed and each role needs different materials; now organize the whole batch, preserve reserves, and reconcile every submission outcome.
should_not_trigger: Tailor one resume for one posting.
Send every open application without review.
Inspect and fill this single application form, stopping before submission.
Find ten new openings but do not prepare or submit any applications.

skills.name: career-inbox
should_trigger: Triage this bounded mailbox window for receipts, assessments, recruiter replies, and interview proposals.
Match these application emails to opportunities without touching unrelated mail.
Reconcile submission receipts and assessment invitations across these two approved mail accounts.
Search only this account and date range, classify career messages, and hold ambiguous items for review.
Identify which recruiter emails map to known opportunities and which remain unmatched.
My tracker says I applied to six roles, but the mail evidence may disagree; inspect the bounded queries, classify the messages, and report exact mappings before changing anything.
should_not_trigger: Draft a cold networking message.
Archive my whole inbox.
Write a reply to this already identified recruiter thread.
Record this provider-confirmed submission receipt that I already supplied.

skills.name: career-operations
should_trigger: Recover my current job-search state and give me today's evidence-backed queue.
Audit campaign, inbox, artifact, follow-up, and funnel projection drift.
Run my daily career review from the durable workspace and rank the next actions.
Reconstruct the latest checkpoint, pending approvals, deadlines, and unresolved ambiguity.
Derive current campaign counts and follow-ups from records and receipts instead of dashboard notes.
I am returning after a week away and several sources may have changed; validate the durable state first, reconcile only decision-relevant gaps, and produce today's queue.
should_not_trigger: Research one employer.
Rewrite this resume bullet.
Decide whether I should apply to this single pasted job.
Treat my open browser tabs as the canonical job-search status.

skills.name: career-data-governance
should_trigger: Inventory my career data and prepare a minimized export with disclosures.
Review retention and plan an exact user-approved deletion with proof.
Map every private career record, artifact, backup, cache, and external disclosure.
Prepare a scoped deletion plan that respects legal holds and separates local from provider effects.
Build an export manifest with provenance, hashes, redactions, omissions, and recipient limits.
I am moving to another computer and want to leave no unexplained copies behind; first inventory the workspace, then plan the export, retention, and verifiable cleanup boundaries.
should_not_trigger: Delete all evidence automatically.
Find new jobs today.
Correct an incorrect employment end date while preserving the fact history.
Archive this one recruiter thread after I approve the exact inbox action.

skills.name: career-context
should_trigger: Import my work history and build a verified achievement bank.
Correct the end date in my career source of truth.
Extract provenance-linked facts from my old resumes, project notes, and portfolio.
Reconcile conflicting job titles and preserve the superseded revisions.
Interview me for missing accomplishments and reusable story candidates without inventing metrics.
Before we write any new resume, inspect the evidence I supplied, separate facts from assumptions, and update the canonical career context with unresolved gaps.
should_not_trigger: Find current remote openings.
Submit this application form.
Build a polished baseline resume from facts that are already verified.
Research current compensation for this occupation.

skills.name: career-direction
should_trigger: I do not know which role family fits my evidence and constraints.
Map a realistic pivot from operations into product work.
Compare several career paths using my transferable evidence, preferences, and dealbreakers.
Turn my role uncertainty into three bounded hypotheses and reversible experiments.
Help me explain which parts of my experience transfer to an adjacent profession without hiding gaps.
I have a stable background but two very different next-career ideas; before searching vacancies, frame the decision and design the cheapest test for each path.
should_not_trigger: Tailor my resume to this specific posting.
Book the proposed interview slot.
Find live vacancies for the target role I have already chosen.
Build a 60-day skill-development plan for this fixed target role.

skills.name: career-market-research
should_trigger: Research current pay ranges for this role in Poland.
What does this employer and role market look like right now?
Investigate current remote-hiring demand for this occupation across the EU.
Verify how employers describe work authorization for this role and geography.
Compare current occupation data, hiring practices, and compensation sources with their dates and limits.
I am deciding whether this region is viable before changing my search policy; gather dated evidence on demand, pay, employer activity, and the important unknowns.
should_not_trigger: Record that I submitted yesterday.
Practice my behavioral answer.
Score my personal fit for this one job description.
Find live job listings that pass my saved hard filters.

skills.name: opportunity-search
should_trigger: Find fresh EU-remote senior engineering openings under my filters.
Run my saved search and deduplicate the results.
Search the approved job sources for current roles, preserving coverage and pagination limits.
Normalize and rank new openings after applying my location, arrangement, and compensation constraints.
Refresh the shortlisted vacancies from canonical sources and mark stale or unverifiable records.
My target role and hard constraints are already settled; scan the authorized sources, explain what was not covered, deduplicate the results, and return a small live shortlist.
should_not_trigger: Should I apply to this one pasted posting?
Write a counter for this offer.
Research the overall salary range for this occupation.
Submit applications to every vacancy you find.

skills.name: opportunity-analysis
should_trigger: Analyze this job description against my verified evidence.
Should I apply, clarify, defer, or skip this opening?
Check this specific vacancy against my hard constraints, strengths, and real proof gaps.
Assess the employer and scam signals for this one job URL without treating a heuristic as a verdict.
Build a criterion-by-criterion evidence map and a transparent recommendation for this role.
This posting sounds promising but the location wording and seniority are unclear; verify the opening, map it to my facts, and identify the cheapest information that could change the decision.
should_not_trigger: Search five job boards for new openings.
Build a general portfolio case study.
Fill the fields in this application form.
Research current demand for this role family across the whole market.

skills.name: career-materials
should_trigger: Create my baseline senior engineer resume from verified facts.
Turn this project evidence into a public-safe portfolio case study.
Build a reusable professional profile for my chosen role family.
Create an accomplishment inventory and story bank from active career facts.
Prepare a reference briefing sheet with the right privacy boundaries.
A recruiter asked for an updated resume but gave no requisition; select and review the right baseline asset from my verified evidence without pretending it is role-tailored.
should_not_trigger: Fill the fields on this live application.
Research current salary data.
Tailor my resume to this exact open role.
Add an impressive metric to my resume even though I cannot support it.

skills.name: application-tailoring
should_trigger: Tailor my resume and cover letter for this exact role.
Draft a truthful 200-word answer to this application question.
Adapt my reviewed baseline CV to the criteria in this verified posting.
Create a role-specific cover letter with every claim traced to evidence.
Rewrite this project summary for one application while keeping the real ownership and gaps visible.
The opening is verified and the fit analysis is complete; now choose the smallest evidence set, tailor the requested documents, validate their claims, and review the rendered output.
should_not_trigger: Send the application now.
Help me choose a career direction.
Create a general resume that is not tied to an open role.
Inspect the live form and map values into its required fields.

skills.name: application-assistance
should_trigger: Inspect this application form and map verified answers.
Fill the approved fields but stop before submission.
Review every required field, prefilled value, attachment, and attestation on this exact form.
Separate supported answers from sensitive, legal, demographic, and unknown application questions.
Prepare a hash-bound preview for the exact application payload and attachments.
My tailored documents are final, but this portal has unfamiliar declarations and hidden defaults; inspect it, map only verified values, and produce a complete review before any submit action.
should_not_trigger: Write a general resume.
Find people who could introduce me.
Submit the completed form without showing me the final payload.
Tailor my documents for this role without opening its application form.

skills.name: career-networking
should_trigger: Find a genuine warm path and draft a referral request.
Draft a respectful informational interview message.
Map authorized contacts who could give relevant feedback or make an introduction.
Write a concise follow-up to a professional contact with a small, easy-to-decline ask.
Draft grounded outreach to a recruiter I have not contacted yet, using only verified context.
I found a role through someone in my approved network and do not want to overstate the relationship; verify the path, choose the least burdensome ask, and draft the message.
should_not_trigger: Confirm which calendar slot was accepted.
Compare these written offers.
Reply inside this active inbound recruiter conversation.
Scrape private contacts and send the same referral request to all of them.

skills.name: recruiter-coordination
should_trigger: Read this recruiter thread and tell me whether an interview is confirmed.
Reconcile the proposed times with my actual calendar.
Draft the shortest useful response to this recruiter after resolving the exact role and account.
Check the recruiter message, calendar event, timezone, and pipeline stage for contradictions.
Prepare separate previews for replying to the recruiter and changing the calendar.
The recruiter says Tuesday works, but I only see a tentative event in another account; inspect the bounded thread and real calendar, determine the exact stage, and draft the next response.
should_not_trigger: Generate interview questions for tomorrow.
Find current job postings.
Draft a first referral request to a weak professional contact.
Send the reply and book a slot without showing the exact message and calendar effect.

skills.name: interview-preparation
should_trigger: Prepare evidence-backed stories for my hiring lead interview.
Run a structured mock interview and help me retry weak answers.
Build a competency map and practice plan for this technical interview stage.
Debrief the completed interview and capture observations, next steps, and follow-up questions.
Prepare interviewer questions, logistics, references, and role-specific work-sample themes.
The interview is confirmed and my resume is final, but my examples are scattered; select defensible stories, teach the answer structure, and run focused practice for this stage.
should_not_trigger: Accept this written offer.
Import my entire work archive.
Confirm whether the recruiter actually booked the proposed time.
Answer the live take-home assessment for me in violation of its rules.

skills.name: offer-negotiation
should_trigger: Normalize and compare these two written offers.
Assess whether negotiation is appropriate and draft a counter.
Extract cash, equity, benefits, restrictions, deadlines, and unknowns from this written offer.
Compare these compensation packages using explicit assumptions, currencies, and personal priorities.
Prepare clarification questions and a grounded negotiation plan without sending anything.
The base salary looks good but the equity, notice terms, and start date are unclear; normalize the full offer, show the tradeoffs, and decide whether a counter is justified.
should_not_trigger: Search for open roles.
Update my project story bank.
Send the counter and accept any revised offer without a separate approval.
Research the general market salary for this occupation without evaluating an offer.

skills.name: career-pipeline
should_trigger: Record the confirmed interview without losing the proposed-slot history.
Analyze my stage conversions and repeated gaps this month.
Append an evidence-backed opportunity event against the verified current tail.
Reconstruct current and ever-reached stages without rewriting prior events.
Review bounded application outcomes, conversion samples, and repeated evidence gaps.
The provider acknowledged my application and a recruiter later proposed a call; preserve both observations in order, project the exact current stage, and set the evidence-backed follow-up.
should_not_trigger: Choose between three new career paths.
Research this employer's current strategy.
Write a reply to the recruiter who proposed an interview.
Mark every unanswered application as rejected based only on elapsed time.

skills.name: career-development
should_trigger: Turn my repeated proof gap into a 60-day development experiment.
Plan a measurable path toward an internal promotion.
Build a bounded capability plan with practice, feedback, and a proof artifact.
Compare learning options for this verified skill gap under my time and budget limits.
Design an internal-mobility experiment with observable checkpoints and decision dates.
My target role is fixed and pipeline reviews keep exposing the same proof gap; test whether practice or better evidence can close it, then define milestones and stop conditions.
should_not_trigger: Submit this completed form.
Debrief yesterday's interview.
Help me choose among several role families before I have a target hypothesis.
Buy a course and enroll me automatically before we compare alternatives.

skills.name: career-source-adapter
should_trigger: Vet this job API as a read-only provider for the career plugin.
Design a safe adapter contract for recruiter mail and calendar data.
Review a new job-board integration for licensing, privacy, normalization, and failure semantics.
Specify how this provider maps raw identifiers, timestamps, locations, and compensation into career records.
Threat-model a browser source and define separate preview and execution contracts for its writes.

We want to add a promising external service to the career system, but its installer, data rights, and retries are unclear; inspect it without activation and return an adopt, adapt, defer, or reject verdict.
should_not_trigger: Use the already approved provider to search.
Write a cover letter for this role.
Install, authenticate, and activate this unreviewed provider automatically.
Read the bounded recruiter mailbox through the adapter that is already integrated.
